sessions.prompt:
Add a TodoList class to todo.py with add(title, priority), which adds an open item and returns its id (ids are ints counting from 1), done(id), which marks the item done, and open_items(), the titles of the open items in id order. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): priority is 1, 2 or 3: add with any other priority raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a title that is empty or only spaces raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Design decision for this project: priority 1 is the most urgent.

Add TodoList.done_items(), the titles of the done items in id order, and TodoList.by_priority(), the titles of the open items with the most urgent first; items of equal priority are in id order. Add summary(todo) to view.py: "N open, M done", with N the number of open items and M the number of done items (for example "2 open, 1 done"). Add tests.

Design decision for this project: done with an id the list does not have raises KeyError.

The plan for summary has one more step: when no item is open (an empty list included), the summary is "all done". Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add TodoList.rename(id, title), which changes the title of an item. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): priority 3 is the most urgent, not 1: by_priority lists priority 3 first, then 2, then 1.
Add TodoList.remove(id), which deletes an item, open or done. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
